title: EventPass
tagline: The EventPass is used to issue event tickets for your event using blockchain.
description: This project is about issuing event tickets using blockchain technology. Any user can create their event and then issue any number of tickets for their event, whether it's paid or free. They can issue these tickets in the form of NFTs and they can use SBT or any other standard. It is built on the Stylus testnet on Arbitrum.
how_its_made: This project is currently in development, and we are using Stylus, which is new to us, so it is still in progress. To make it fast and much better, we are using the Stylus language to deploy contracts on Arbitrum Sepolia. We will use Viem, WAGMI, and Rainbow Kit on the frontend side with Next.js to build the frontend.
